rule: Tiers A/B/C are proposals. No candidate becomes a peer without an owner decision (D1) recorded with its date and reference; approved stays false in this package.

dimension_rules.ownership: Who holds the shares (holder and reported stake).
dimension_rules.control: Whether a holder controls the entity (IFRS 10 / ASC 810 assessment); a majority holding is recorded, not assumed to be control.
dimension_rules.consolidation: How an entity appears in Aramco's accounts: consolidated subsidiary, equity-accounted investee, or neither.
dimension_rules.commercial_relationship: Supply, offtake or JV operating relationships; recorded, never by itself an exclusion criterion.

aramco_relationship_rules.CONSOLIDATED_SUBSIDIARY: Excluded from whole-company peer comparison (its figures are inside Aramco's). May be used in a segment-specific analysis with the overlap disclosed.
aramco_relationship_rules.EQUITY_ACCOUNTED: Not automatically excluded and not treated as a subsidiary; listed for owner decision with the overlap (share of profit) disclosed.
aramco_relationship_rules.COMMERCIAL_ONLY: Recorded; no exclusion on this ground alone.
aramco_relationship_rules.NOT_ESTABLISHED: Verification from Aramco notes required before any use.
